title: He Turned Rain Into Money
description:
Marlo got soaked every time it rained, because he never remembered his umbrella. Then he saw twenty people stuck under the bakery roof.

Watch how a barrel of cheap umbrellas turned into a business, the wind that flipped every single one inside out, and the free cookie that beat MegaSock's $12 umbrella machine.

New Marble Street story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next business.

Marble Street is an animated series about creative business ideas. Marlo, his street and every event are fictional. Made with an AI voice and computer animation.
